answer: Grade what you can verify: every answer settles into a delta of published trails, each claim branching into its evidence, so peers grade the delta, not the storyteller. A sybil floods the plain with a thousand shallow channels leading nowhere; graders weighing only verifiable shale, hard deposits that hold a load, watch them wash out at the first jetty of honest review. Fake volume buys width, never depth, and payouts follow depth: one channel cut through real work earns the epoch's flow; a thousand hollow ones dry up.
